method: Whole240 HAC slope interval with SG047 pooled calibration z=2.291027529910169 always preserved. SG047 boundary scan score>.5186019321 triggers secondary post-changepoint interval z=5.3461295114. Only direct non-unresolved label contradiction changes the primary decision to unresolved. No local interval substitutes for full history.

pilot.disclosure: SG048 withheld one correct decision, fixed zero errors in disclosed pilot. Freeze preceded untouched holdout.

findings: Warning-only use of the boundary did not prevent wrong decisions; 39 FP persist under pooled and SG048.
SG048 worsened loss by 18 against the pooled full240 baseline due to withholding one correct rejection.
SG046 improved coverage from 633 to 641 but had one more wrong classification and higher loss than pooled on these seeds.

Every remaining incorrect SG048 classification was a false confirmation; model labels any interval outside zero, including negative estimates, as confirmed drift. The positive-only drift experimental hypothesis merits a directional gate test.
Earlier SG047 lost information by truncating; SG048 preserved full-history but challenge had negligible discriminative power.
limitations: All experiments synthetic; heldout random seeds from predefined generator families, not external data.
The study is retrospective and uses full 240 continuation samples for all policies, with no actual savings in observations.
Local and full slopes share the same observations so disagreement is not an independent source.
Changing a correct decision to unresolved is assessed against known synthetic truth only, never available during deployment.
The GitHub source imports sibling SG047 and SG043 files; source committed and re-fetched, but clean checkout execution was not separately verified.
